questions.scenario: Various options are given as possible answers to the following questions. Choose the correct answer.

questions.qAf: Watter mikro-organisme het geen selstruktuur nie en kan slegs binne ’n lewende gasheersel voortplant?

questions.q: Malaria is caused by a …
questions.qAf: Malaria word veroorsaak deur ’n …

questions.q: Antibiotics are effective against …
questions.qAf: Antibiotika is doeltreffend teen …

questions.q: Which plant group has vascular tissue but does NOT produce seeds?
questions.qAf: Watter plantgroep het vaatweefsel maar produseer NIE sade nie?

questions.q: The transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma is called …
questions.qAf: Die oordrag van stuifmeel van ’n helmknop na ’n stempel word … genoem.

questions.q: Animals whose bodies develop from three germ layers are …
questions.qAf: Diere waarvan die liggame uit drie kiemlae ontwikkel, is …

questions.q: The enzyme that starts protein digestion in the stomach is …

questions.scenario: Give the correct biological term for each of the following descriptions.
questions.scenarioAf: Gee die korrekte biologiese term vir elk van die volgende beskrywings.

questions.q: A micro-organism that causes disease
questions.qAf: ’n Mikro-organisme wat siekte veroorsaak

questions.q: A preparation of weakened or dead pathogens that makes the body immune
questions.qAf: ’n Preparaat van verswakte of dooie patogene wat die liggaam immuun maak

questions.q: The part of a flower that receives pollen
questions.qAf: Die deel van ’n blom wat stuifmeel ontvang

questions.q: Plants that produce naked seeds, often in cones
questions.qAf: Plante wat naakte sade produseer, dikwels in keëls

questions.q: The green pigment that absorbs light energy
questions.qAf: Die groen pigment wat ligenergie absorbeer

questions.q: The movement of digested food into the blood and lymph
questions.qAf: Die beweging van verteerde voedsel na die bloed en limf

questions.q: Finger-like projections on the inner wall of the small intestine
questions.qAf: Vingeragtige uitsteeksels op die binnewand van die dunderm

questions.q: A fluid-filled body cavity lined by mesoderm

questions.q:
Has vascular tissue

questions.scenario: A water plant (pondweed) was placed at different distances from a lamp, and the number of gas bubbles it released per minute was counted. A beaker of water was placed between the lamp and the plant.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Waterplant (damplant) is op verskillende afstande van ’n lamp geplaas, en die aantal gasborrels wat dit per minuut vrygestel het, is getel. ’n Beker water is tussen die lamp en die plant geplaas.

questions.q: Identify the independent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike veranderlike.
points: light intensity (distance from the lamp)
pointsAf: ligintensiteit (afstand van die lamp)

questions.q: Identify the dependent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die afhanklike veranderlike.
points: the number of bubbles per minute (rate of photosynthesis)
pointsAf: die aantal borrels per minuut (tempo van fotosintese)

questions.q: Name the gas in the bubbles.
questions.qAf: Noem die gas in die borrels.
points: oxygen
pointsAf: suurstof

questions.q: Describe the trend shown by the results.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die neiging wat die resultate toon.
points: As the distance from the lamp increases (light intensity decreases)
the number of bubbles per minute decreases
pointsAf: Soos die afstand van die lamp toeneem (ligintensiteit afneem)
neem die aantal borrels per minuut af

questions.q: Why was a beaker of water placed between the lamp and the plant?
questions.qAf: Waarom is ’n beker water tussen die lamp en die plant geplaas?
points: To absorb the heat from the lamp
so that temperature stays constant and only light intensity changes
pointsAf: Om die hitte van die lamp te absorbeer
sodat die temperatuur konstant bly en slegs die ligintensiteit verander

questions.q: Draw a line graph of the results.
questions.qAf: Teken ’n lyngrafiek van die resultate.
points: Correct type of graph (line graph)
Caption that names both variables
x-axis: distance from the lamp (cm) with a suitable scale
y-axis: number of bubbles per minute with a suitable scale
All points plotted correctly
pointsAf: Korrekte soort grafiek (lyngrafiek)
Opskrif wat albei veranderlikes noem
x-as: afstand van die lamp (cm) met ’n geskikte skaal
y-as: aantal borrels per minuut met ’n geskikte skaal
Al die punte korrek gestip

questions.q: Name ONE other variable that had to be kept constant.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN ander veranderlike wat konstant gehou moes word.
points: the amount of carbon dioxide in the water, the temperature, or the same plant
pointsAf: die hoeveelheid koolstofdioksied in die water, die temperatuur, of dieselfde plant

questions.q: Why should the bubbles be counted for several minutes at each distance and an average calculated?
questions.qAf: Waarom moet die borrels vir ’n paar minute by elke afstand getel en ’n gemiddelde bereken word?
points: To make the results more reliable
pointsAf: Om die resultate meer betroubaar te maak

questions.q: Name the FOUR groups of micro-organisms.
questions.qAf: Noem die VIER groepe mikro-organismes.
points: viruses
bacteria
protists
fungi
pointsAf: virusse
bakterieë
protiste
swamme

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which bacteria are useful.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop bakterieë nuttig is.
points: decomposition of dead matter, or nitrogen fixation
making foods such as yoghurt and cheese, or producing medicines
pointsAf: ontbinding van dooie materiaal, of stikstofbinding
die maak van voedsel soos jogurt en kaas, of die produksie van medisyne

questions.q: Explain how HIV weakens the immune system.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe MIV die immuunstelsel verswak.
points: HIV infects and destroys white blood cells (T-helper cells)
so the body can no longer fight other infections
pointsAf: MIV besmet en vernietig witbloedselle (T-helperselle)
dus kan die liggaam nie meer ander infeksies beveg nie

questions.q: Explain how a vaccine makes a person immune to a disease.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n entstof ’n persoon immuun teen ’n siekte maak.
points: The vaccine contains weakened or dead pathogens (antigens)
the body makes antibodies and memory cells
when the real pathogen enters later, the memory cells respond quickly before the person becomes ill
pointsAf: Die entstof bevat verswakte of dooie patogene (antigene)
die liggaam maak teenliggaampies en geheueselle
wanneer die regte patogeen later binnedring, reageer die geheueselle vinnig voordat die persoon siek word

questions.q: Name the type of micro-organism that causes tuberculosis (TB) and give ONE symptom of TB.
questions.qAf: Noem die soort mikro-organisme wat tuberkulose (TB) veroorsaak en gee EEN simptoom van TB.
points: a bacterium
a cough that lasts for weeks, weight loss, or night sweats
pointsAf: ’n bakterie
’n hoes wat weke duur, gewigsverlies, of nagsweet

questions.q: Explain why a doctor does not prescribe antibiotics for flu.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n dokter nie antibiotika vir griep voorskryf nie.
points: Flu is caused by a virus, and antibiotics work only against bacteria
pointsAf: Griep word deur ’n virus veroorsaak, en antibiotika werk slegs teen bakterieë

questions.q: Name the FOUR divisions of the plant kingdom, from the simplest to the most complex.
questions.qAf: Noem die VIER afdelings van die planteryk, van die eenvoudigste tot die mees komplekse.
points: bryophytes
pteridophytes
gymnosperms
angiosperms
pointsAf: briofiete
pteridofiete
gimnosperme
angiosperme

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of seeds over spores.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele van sade bo spore.
points: A seed contains a food store for the embryo
a seed coat protects it, so it can stay dormant through bad conditions
pointsAf: ’n Saad bevat ’n voedselvoorraad vir die embrio
’n saadhuid beskerm dit, sodat dit deur slegte toestande dormant kan bly

questions.q: Explain why mosses are small and grow in damp places.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom mosse klein is en op klam plekke groei.
points: They have no vascular tissue (xylem) to transport water and give support
and they need water for the sperm to swim to the egg
pointsAf: Hulle het geen vaatweefsel (xileem) om water te vervoer en steun te gee nie
en hulle het water nodig sodat die sperm na die eiersel kan swem

questions.q: What is meant by alternation of generations?
questions.qAf: Wat word bedoel met generasiewisseling?
points: The life cycle alternates between a haploid gametophyte generation
and a diploid sporophyte generation
pointsAf: Die lewensiklus wissel af tussen ’n haploïede gametofietgenerasie
en ’n diploïede sporofietgenerasie

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which plants are important to people.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop plante belangrik vir mense is.
points: food
medicine, timber, fibre or oxygen
pointsAf: voedsel
medisyne, hout, vesel of suurstof

questions.q: Tabulate THREE differences between insect-pollinated and wind-pollinated flowers.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer DRIE verskille tussen insekbestuifde en windbestuifde blomme.
points: Insect: large, colourful petals / Wind: small, dull petals or none
Insect: scent and nectar / Wind: no scent or nectar
Insect: sticky pollen in small amounts / Wind: light, smooth pollen in large amounts
pointsAf: Insek: groot, kleurvolle kroonblare / Wind: klein, dowwe kroonblare of geen
Insek: geur en nektar / Wind: geen geur of nektar nie
Insek: taai stuifmeel in klein hoeveelhede / Wind: ligte, gladde stuifmeel in groot hoeveelhede

questions.q: Describe what happens after pollination to bring about fertilisation.
questions.qAf: Beskryf wat ná bestuiwing gebeur om bevrugting te bewerkstellig.
points: A pollen tube grows from the pollen grain down through the style
the male nucleus moves down the tube into the ovule
and fuses with the egg cell to form a zygote
pointsAf: ’n Stuifmeelbuis groei uit die stuifmeelkorrel af deur die styl
die manlike kern beweeg teen die buis af na die saadknop
en versmelt met die eiersel om ’n sigoot te vorm

questions.q: After fertilisation, what does (a) the ovule and (b) the ovary develop into?
questions.qAf: Waarin ontwikkel (a) die saadknop en (b) die vrugbeginsel ná bevrugting?
points: (a) a seed
(b) a fruit
pointsAf: (a) ’n saad
(b) ’n vrug

questions.q: Name TWO methods of asexual (vegetative) reproduction used by farmers and gardeners.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE metodes van ongeslagtelike (vegetatiewe) voortplanting wat deur boere en tuiniers gebruik word.
points: cuttings
grafting, tissue culture or bulbs
pointsAf: steggies
enting, weefselkultuur of bolle

questions.q: Why are seed banks important?
questions.qAf: Waarom is saadbanke belangrik?
points: They store seeds to preserve genetic diversity and protect species from extinction
pointsAf: Hulle berg sade om genetiese diversiteit te bewaar en spesies teen uitsterwing te beskerm

questions.q: What is a phylum?
questions.qAf: Wat is ’n filum?
points: A large group of organisms that share the same basic body plan
pointsAf: ’n Groot groep organismes wat dieselfde basiese liggaamsplan deel

questions.q: Name the phylum to which each animal belongs: (a) a segmented worm with a hydrostatic skeleton, (b) an animal with jointed legs and an exoskeleton, (c) a radially symmetrical animal with stinging cells, (d) a flatworm with a gut that has only one opening.
questions.qAf: Noem die filum waaraan elke dier behoort: (a) ’n gesegmenteerde wurm met ’n hidrostatiese skelet, (b) ’n dier met gelede pote en ’n eksoskelet, (c) ’n radiaal simmetriese dier met netelselle, (d) ’n platwurm met ’n spysverteringskanaal met slegs een opening.
points: (a) Annelida
(b) Arthropoda
(c) Cnidaria
(d) Platyhelminthes
pointsAf: (a) Annelida
(b) Arthropoda
(c) Cnidaria
(d) Platyhelminthes

questions.q: Distinguish between diploblastic and triploblastic animals.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen diploblastiese en triploblastiese diere.
points: Diploblastic animals develop from two germ layers (ectoderm and endoderm)
triploblastic animals develop from three germ layers (with mesoderm in between)
pointsAf: Diploblastiese diere ontwikkel uit twee kiemlae (ektoderm en endoderm)
triploblastiese diere ontwikkel uit drie kiemlae (met mesoderm tussenin)

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of having a coelom.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele daarvan om ’n seloom te hê.
points: The organs have space to develop and can move independently of the body wall
the fluid can act as a hydrostatic skeleton or help with transport
pointsAf: Die organe het ruimte om te ontwikkel en kan onafhanklik van die liggaamswand beweeg
die vloeistof kan as ’n hidrostatiese skelet dien of met vervoer help

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of a through-gut (a gut with a mouth and an anus).
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele van ’n deurlopende spysverteringskanaal (met ’n mond en ’n anus).
points: Food moves in one direction
different regions can specialise for different stages of digestion
pointsAf: Voedsel beweeg in een rigting
verskillende dele kan vir verskillende stadiums van vertering spesialiseer

questions.q: State ONE advantage of cephalisation.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN voordeel van sefalisasie.
points: Sense organs are concentrated at the front end, so the animal detects its surroundings as it moves forward
pointsAf: Sintuie is aan die voorkant gekonsentreer, sodat die dier sy omgewing waarneem terwyl dit vorentoe beweeg

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which invertebrates are important in agriculture.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop ongewerweldes belangrik is in die landbou.
points: Insects such as bees pollinate crops
earthworms aerate and enrich the soil, or some insects control pests
pointsAf: Insekte soos bye bestuif gewasse
erdwurms belug en verryk die grond, of sommige insekte beheer plae

questions.q: Name, in the correct order, the FIVE stages in the processing of food.
questions.qAf: Noem, in die korrekte volgorde, die VYF stadiums in die verwerking van voedsel.
points: ingestion
digestion
absorption
assimilation
egestion
pointsAf: inname
vertering
absorpsie
assimilasie
egestie

questions.q: Distinguish between mechanical and chemical digestion.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen meganiese en chemiese vertering.
points: Mechanical digestion breaks food into smaller pieces physically, e.g. by chewing
chemical digestion breaks large molecules into small, soluble molecules with enzymes
pointsAf: Meganiese vertering breek voedsel fisies in kleiner stukke, bv. deur te kou
chemiese vertering breek groot molekules met ensieme in klein, oplosbare molekules af

questions.q: Tabulate TWO differences between the teeth of a herbivore and the teeth of a carnivore.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer TWEE verskille tussen die tande van ’n herbivoor en die tande van ’n karnivoor.
points: Herbivore: broad, ridged molars for grinding / Carnivore: sharp carnassial teeth for cutting
Herbivore: small or no canines, with a diastema / Carnivore: long, pointed canines for gripping
pointsAf: Herbivoor: breë, geriffelde kiestande om te maal / Karnivoor: skerp skeurtande om te sny
Herbivoor: klein of geen oogtande nie, met ’n diasteem / Karnivoor: lang, skerp oogtande om vas te gryp

questions.q: Name the liquid made by the liver that helps with fat digestion, and state its function.
questions.qAf: Noem die vloeistof wat deur die lewer gemaak word en met vetvertering help, en noem sy funksie.
points: bile
it emulsifies fats into small droplets, which gives lipase a larger surface area
pointsAf: gal
dit emulgeer vette in klein druppeltjies, wat lipase ’n groter oppervlakte gee

questions.q: Name the disease caused by a severe shortage of protein in the diet of young children.
questions.qAf: Noem die siekte wat deur ’n ernstige tekort aan proteïen in die dieet van jong kinders veroorsaak word.
points: kwashiorkor
pointsAf: kwashiorkor

questions.q: Name the product of starch digestion by salivary amylase.
questions.qAf: Noem die produk van styselvertering deur speekselamilase.
points: maltose
pointsAf: maltose

questions.q: Name the products of fat digestion.
questions.qAf: Noem die produkte van vetvertering.
points: fatty acids
glycerol
pointsAf: vetsure
gliserol

questions.q: Explain why pepsin stops working when it reaches the duodenum.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom pepsien ophou werk wanneer dit die duodenum bereik.
points: The duodenum is alkaline
pepsin works best in acidic conditions, so it becomes inactive (denatured)
pointsAf: Die duodenum is alkalies
pepsien werk die beste in suur toestande, dus word dit onaktief (gedenatureer)

questions.q: Explain why a person whose gall bladder has been removed is advised to eat a low-fat diet.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n persoon wie se galblaas verwyder is, aangeraai word om ’n laevet-dieet te eet.
points: Less bile is stored and released at mealtimes
so fats are not emulsified well and are poorly digested
pointsAf: Minder gal word gestoor en tydens etes vrygestel
dus word vette nie goed geëmulgeer nie en swak verteer

questions.q: Give TWO functions of hydrochloric acid in the stomach.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE funksies van soutsuur in die maag.
points: It kills bacteria in the food
it provides the acidic pH that pepsin needs
pointsAf: Dit maak bakterieë in die voedsel dood
dit verskaf die suur pH wat pepsien nodig het

questions.q: Give TWO health risks of obesity.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE gesondheidsrisiko’s van vetsug.
points: heart disease
type 2 diabetes or high blood pressure
pointsAf: hartsiektes
tipe 2-diabetes of hoë bloeddruk

questions.q: Name the part of the gut where most of the water is reabsorbed.
questions.qAf: Noem die deel van die spysverteringskanaal waar die meeste water herabsorbeer word.
points: large intestine (colon)
pointsAf: dikderm (kolon)

questions.q:
Describe how starch and proteins in a meal are digested in the human gut, and explain how the small intestine is adapted for the absorption of the digested food.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf hoe stysel en proteïene in ’n maaltyd in die menslike spysverteringskanaal verteer word, en verduidelik hoe die dunderm aangepas is vir die absorpsie van die verteerde voedsel.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: Teeth chew the food (mechanical digestion), which increases its surface area
Salivary amylase in the mouth starts breaking starch down to maltose
Peristalsis moves the food along the gut and the stomach churns it
In the stomach, pepsin breaks proteins down into shorter chains (peptides)
Hydrochloric acid gives the acidic pH that pepsin needs
In the duodenum, pancreatic amylase continues to break starch down to maltose
Trypsin from the pancreas breaks proteins and peptides down further
Maltase changes maltose into glucose
Peptidases change peptides into amino acids
The small intestine is very long, which gives more time and surface for absorption
Its inner wall is folded and covered with villi, which increase the surface area
The villi have microvilli that increase the surface area even more
The wall of each villus is one cell thick, so the diffusion distance is short
Each villus has a dense network of blood capillaries that keeps the concentration gradient steep
Glucose and amino acids are absorbed into the blood by diffusion and active transport
Each villus has a lacteal that absorbs fatty acids and glycerol
The hepatic portal vein carries the absorbed food to the liver
pointsAf: Tande kou die voedsel (meganiese vertering), wat sy oppervlakte vergroot
Speekselamilase in die mond begin om stysel na maltose af te breek
Peristalse beweeg die voedsel deur die spysverteringskanaal en die maag karring dit
In die maag breek pepsien proteïene af in korter kettings (peptiede)
Soutsuur gee die suur pH wat pepsien nodig het
In die duodenum breek pankreasamilase stysel verder na maltose af
Tripsien uit die pankreas breek proteïene en peptiede verder af
Maltase verander maltose in glukose
Peptidases verander peptiede in aminosure
Die dunderm is baie lank, wat meer tyd en oppervlakte vir absorpsie gee
Sy binnewand is gevou en met villi bedek, wat die oppervlakte vergroot
Die villi het mikrovilli wat die oppervlakte nog meer vergroot
Die wand van elke villus is een sel dik, dus is die diffusie-afstand kort
Elke villus het ’n digte netwerk bloedkapillêre wat die konsentrasiegradiënt steil hou
Glukose en aminosure word deur diffusie en aktiewe transport in die bloed geabsorbeer
Elke villus het ’n melkvat (lakteaal) wat vetsure en gliserol absorbeer
Die hepatiese poortaar vervoer die geabsorbeerde voedsel na die lewer

questions.q: Synthesis
questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about digestion and absorption; nothing irrelevant
Logical sequence (1): digestion is described in order from the mouth to the small intestine
Comprehensive (1): at least 6/9 for digestion and 5/8 for absorption
pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor vertering en absorpsie; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): vertering word in volgorde van die mond tot die dunderm beskryf
Omvattend (1): ten minste 6/9 vir vertering en 5/8 vir absorpsie
